narrative.scqa_md:
Financial Partners Credit Union is a $2.5B in assets credit union regulated by NCUA + CA DFPI (dual regulated), operating since 1937 with 282 employees. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.5/5. The deepest capability gap is Notification Template & Alert Configuration at 2.1/5 against a 2.8 peer median [E-084, E-082]. Next is Roadmap & Planning at 2.2/5 against a 2.8 peer median [E-004, E-005].

Third is Project/Program Governance at 2.2/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-036]. The issue register adds Specificity test (<20% generic): 35% generic (7/20 sampled paras) (high severity). Counter-signal: Risk Reporting & Analytics already runs at 2.8/5 against a 2.5 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild. The pattern is corroborated across the assessment's evidence index [E-002].

The roster shows no CISO — a named ownership gap for the capabilities below. The question for Financial Partners Credit Union is whether to close Notification Template & Alert Configuration first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Financial Partners Credit Union should lead with nCino (77/100 fit) against Onboarding Content & Education, then sequence Databricks behind it. Closing Notification Template & Alert Configuration to the peer median alone is worth 0.6 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.

The analyst's own priority framing: "Reset enterprise priorities + governance cadence to close the 19 P1 capability gaps that surfaced in this assessment.".
